Path: ② the capabilities an end user meets in the app — one address per app | 缺项 | P3

## Triage: first grade, `bug` (was `enhancement`) · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:devpath` · `pm:queue`. Filed as ②, but an accepted ADR answers it: routes key on the package id

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-07T17:14Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/app-shell/src/layout/InboxPopover.tsx:208` (`goToApprovals` builds the path from `currentAppName ?? params.appName`, so the app name wins over the route's own segment) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: a Studio or console surface in objectui. Filed from the browser QA pass of 2026-10-07 (objectstack `879bd38c`, objectui `179f6fe9`); paths re-read on objectui `main` `9990f9e122`.

- **Why not the decision box:** ADR-0048 option A keys `/apps/<segment>` on the package id, with the app name kept only as a fallback alias (`packages/app-shell/src/utils/appRoute.ts:1`–`16`). The approvals link breaks that rule. Why p3: both addresses resolve.
- **Direction:**
  - build the link from `hostAppSegment` (`:224`, the resolver the record link in the same file already moved to, per the comment at `:249`)
  - check the other app-scoped links for the same `name`-first build
- Pin: from `/apps/com.example.showcase/…`, *View approvals* lands on `/apps/com.example.showcase/system/approvals`.
- `Clause-②: no`. Patch changeset in objectui.
